acceptanceCriteria: Reproduce or refute the check/exec gap with a test that swaps the toolchain after verification
If confirmed, execute the verified bytes and prove the swap is refused
Record the outcome in the BBF spec
body: Found by the V1-2011 lane (PR #1285, head 17e98b009, BBF-V0-019..028). Suspected defect, not confirmed: the Go toolchain is digest-checked and then executed from its original location, so a replacement between the check and exec would run an unverified binary (TOCTOU). Expected: execute exactly the bytes that were verified (copy to a private dir, or open+verify the fd). Actual (per lane report): runs in place.

completion.reason: Delivered on main 8def072e08e9730a6102657c887655f62993b31d via batch beamfall/corvint#1430 (lane #1418); CI green on that commit (runs 39631036070,39632775961). Owner 2026-10-21: CI-checked work needs no local full-gate. Evidence file sha256 577b9b315208a0c805b34260438351695c8b3cee73b4bccfc2cd7f24371438df.

title: Suspected: falsification Go toolchain runs in place, leaving a gap between digest check and execution
